name: Landsat 9
summary: Continues a decades-long record of Earth's land surface in many wavelengths, used to track crops, forests and cities.

name: Terra
summary: An Earth-observing satellite whose instruments image land, oceans and the atmosphere in many wavelengths.

name: Van Allen Probes
summary: Twin spacecraft that studied the radiation belts surrounding Earth.

name: ICESat-2
summary: Uses a laser altimeter to measure the height of ice sheets, sea ice, forests and land.

name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO)
summary: Maps the Moon in detail from a low orbit, including its topography, landing sites and cold polar craters.

name: LADEE
summary: Studied the Moon's extremely thin atmosphere and the dust around it from lunar orbit.

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO)
summary: Studies Mars with a high-resolution camera, a spectrometer and a radar that looks beneath the surface for ice.

name: MAVEN
summary: Investigates Mars' upper atmosphere and how the planet lost most of its air to space.

name: Mars Global Surveyor
summary: Mapped Mars' shape with a laser altimeter and discovered magnetic fields frozen into the ancient crust.
